entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?

Hi Diana... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed. I bought a jersey a while back, and I finally got a chance to try it on for a ride this past weekend, and it's completely the wrong size.
I'm sorry to hear that it wasn't the right fit for you. Just to clarify, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the item or a preference with the sizing?

Oh, it's the sizing. It's just way too tight across the chest. I feel terrible calling so late... it's been a couple of months. With everything going on, I just... I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I was really hoping I hadn't wasted my money.
I understand completely. Let me pull up your account to see what we can do. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Shapiro. The order number is... VF88675309.
Thank you, Mark. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the Ascend Pro jersey, purchased 59 days ago. Let me just check the policy for that item.
I just feel so bad about this. I really needed this money if I can't get a new one.
No need to worry, Mark. I have good news. That jersey is a standard VeloFit item, and it falls under our 10-day return policy. You are still unfortunately outside the window to send it back.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Are you sure?
Absolutely. We can definitely get this sorted out. Now, would you prefer to process a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Thank you so much, Diana! I'd love to do an exchange if that's possible. I really love the look of that jersey.

Of course. I've just initiated the exchange process for you and sent a pre-paid return label to your email on file. Just send the original jersey back to us, and we'll ship out the next size up as soon as we receive it. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
You're very welcome, Mark. Have a wonderful day and enjoy your next ride!
